raw_affiliation_strings: Omnia El Shakry is Associate Professor of History at the University of California, Davis, specializing in the cultural and intellectual history of the modern Middle East. She is the author of The Great Social Laboratory: Subjects of Knowledge in Colonial and Postcolonial Egypt (Stanford University Press, 2007) and editor of the multi-volume Gender and Sexuality in Islam (Routledge, forthcoming). Her current book project, The Arabic Freud, traces the development of psychoanalysis and discourses of subjectivity in postwar Egypt as part of the transregional history of ideas of the self. An essay from this project appeared as “The Arabic Freud: The Unconscious and the Modern Subject,” Modern Intellectual History 11, no. 1 (April 2014): 89–118
